arguments.query: select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("outbox","bookings","charges")
select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload,b.status bs from outbox o join bookings b using(booking_id) where o.status!="delivered"

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents ca,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b left join charges c using(booking_id) where b.status="pending"
select event_id,status,attempts,payload from outbox where status!="delivered"

select b.status,count(*) n,sum((select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) ck, sum((select count(*) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and o.status!="delivered")) ob from bookings b group by 1

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") c,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where b.status="pending" or h!=1 or c!=1 or k!=1
select service,status,substr(message,1,50) m,count(*) n,max(rowid) last from request_logs where rowid>(select max(rowid)-120 from request_logs) group by 1,2,3 order by last desc

select o.event_id,o.status,length(o.payload) l,o.payload,b.status bs,b.flight_id,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c from outbox o join bookings b using(booking_id) where o.event_id like "evt_00000395%"
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 5

select b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference from bookings b where request_id in (select request_id from customer_events) or booking_id in ("bkg_3d61c950f0bd5151bb35a6241cfb4e2a","bkg_3afad0f5abe55a06abb7eb2e03bde82c")
